mechanism: Both drugs cause significant nephrotoxicity through different mechanisms (amphotericin B via direct tubular damage and tenofovir via proximal tubule dysfunction), resulting in additive renal injury and increased risk of acute kidney injury.
action: Monitor renal function closely with baseline and frequent serum creatinine, BUN, and electrolyte measurements; consider alternative antifungal or antiretroviral agents if possible; ensure adequate hydration and minimize other nephrotoxic agents.
